{{Meta |missing_NPC_picture = yes |missing_NPC_location = yes |missing_NPC_context = yes |missing_NPC_profile = yes |missing_NPC_idle = yes |missing_NPC_dialogue = yes }} {{Stub}} {{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Cheng.png |type = Open-World |nation = Huanglong |location = Huanglong |group = |affiliation = Lollo Logistics |title = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Cheng''' is a Lollo Logistic NPC in found in Central Plains and Whining Aix's Mire, [[Huanglong]]. They are involved in a series of side quests in the wild.
Similar situation is [[Rong'an]] and [[Xingbai]]. ==Total Reward== {{Event Rewards |Union EXP=80 |Astrite=40 |Medium Resonance Potion=8 |Medium Energy Core=4}} {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== ;(Central Plains) ;'''Cheng''' I'm screwed... There's no way I'm getting them back... :{{DIcon|Quest}} What happened? ::'''Cheng''' I saw someone staring up at something, so I got curious and looked up... ::'''Cheng''' When I turned around, I realized that all the packages I'm delivering had been snatch away by those [[Viridblaze Saurian|damn lizards]]! ::{{DIcon}} ... ::'''Cheng''' Do you think we can sneak up on them and get my packages back? ::{{DIcon}} Leave it to me. :{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave ;(Retrieve Backpack) ;'''Cheng''' You really managed to get them back! :'''Cheng''' Those were some really cool moves! Wow! :'''Cheng''' Oh right, thank you for helping me get my packages back! ---- ;(Central Plains) ;(Defeat Exiles) ;'''Cheng''' Now you'll think twice before coming back to mess with me again! Bah! :{{DIcon|Quest}} Are you all right? ::'''Cheng''' Huh? Oh! Yeah, yeah, I'm fine! I appreciate your help, stranger! ::'''Cheng''' I can't figure out the life of me why these fools keep coming after me! I'm never taking this path again! ::'''Cheng''' Good thing you came to help! Much obliged! :{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave ---- ;(Whining Aix's Mire) ;'''Cheng''' Soooo huuunnngryyyy... :{{DIcon|Quest}} Why are you so hungry? ::'''Cheng''' Oh, don't even get me started. My lunch was stolen! Grrr... Ugh... ::'''Cheng''' Well... Did you pack any extras? :{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave ;(Item delivery) :My hero! Anything will do! Just give me something to eat! :'''Cheng''' Thank you! :'''Cheng''' Oh, this is so good! ---- ;(Whining Aix's Mire) ;'''Cheng''' I don't have any money on me, really. I don't have any! :{{DIcon}} What happened? :'''Cheng''' They're asking me to pay the toll before they would let me pass. But I really don't have any money on me. :'''Cheng''' I even showed them my pockets, and they still won't believe me. Our stations has all the supplies we need, so I don't usually need to carry any money on me. :{{DIcon}} You sure its a good idea to say these things in front of them? :'''Cheng''' Um, yeah... Hey! They're trying to take my clothes! ;(Defeat the Exiles) :'''Cheng''' Phew. They almost got away with it! :'''Cheng''' I'm so glad you helped me out. I need to get going and deliver this package now, or I'll be late for the order. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Cheng |zhs = 阿澄 |zht = 阿澄 |ja = 澄 |ko = 여정 |fr = Cheng |de = Cheng |es = Cheng |th = Cheng }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}}
